Item.Name: BLEED_START_TIME
Item.Hint: Enter bleed start time in HH:MM; do not change date unless necessary

Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :bleed_start_time is null
 then
 :bleed_start_time := trunc(:units.coll_date);
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 if trunc(:bleed_start_time) <> trunc(:units.coll_date)
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date;
 show_error('0145');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :bleed_start_time > sysdate
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date;
 show_error('0141');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :first_sep_time is not null
 then
 if :bleed_start_time >= :first_sep_time
 then
 show_error('0146');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :bleed_start_time is not null and
 :bleed_end_time is not null
 then
 if :bleed_end_time <= :bleed_start_time
 then
 /*show_error('0140');
 check_package_failure;*/
 show_error('0037');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 if round((:units.bleed_end_time - :units.bleed_start_time)*24*60) 
 between
 to_number(:GLOBAL.slow_bleed_time) 
 AND to_number(:GLOBAL.max_bleed_time)
 then
 show_error('9211');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

Item.Name: BLEED_END_TIME
Item.Hint: Enter bleed end time in HH:MM; do not change date unless necessary

Trigger.Name: PRE-TEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :bleed_end_time is null
 then
 :bleed_end_time := trunc(:bleed_start_time);
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_first_sep_time VARCHAR2(10);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 if :bleed_start_time is not null and
 :bleed_end_time is not null
 then
 if :bleed_end_time <= :bleed_start_time
 then
 /*show_error('0140');
 check_package_failure;*/
 show_error('0037');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 if round((:units.bleed_end_time - :units.bleed_start_time)*24*60)
 between 
 to_number(:GLOBAL.slow_bleed_time) AND
 to_number(:GLOBAL.max_bleed_time)
 then
 show_error('9211');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :bleed_end_time > sysdate
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date;
 show_error('0141');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :first_sep_time is not null
 then
 if :bleed_end_time >= :first_sep_time
 then
 show_error('0146');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_cur_record VARCHAR2(2);
 temp_attrib_group VARCHAR2(5);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :s_attribute_group_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'ATTR' and
 code = :attrib_group and
 NVL(length(code), 0) > 1 and /* HCL CODE128 */
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_attribute_group_desc := '';
 :attrib_code := '';
 :s_attribute_code_desc := '';
 show_error('1110');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;


IF :unit_attributes.attrib_group is not null THEN
 temp_cur_record := :system.trigger_record;
 temp_attrib_group := :attrib_group;
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :attrib_group = temp_attrib_group and
 :system.trigger_record != temp_cur_record
 then
 if :attrib_group in ('PHER')
 then
 go_record(temp_cur_record);
 GO_ITEM('attrib_group');
 show_error('0030');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :attrib_group in ('DON')
 then
 go_record(temp_cur_record);
 GO_ITEM('attrib_group');
 show_error('0036');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if; 
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_cur_record VARCHAR2(2);
 temp_attrib_group VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_attrib_code VARCHAR2(4);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select attrib_desc, status_flag,
 stop_label_flag, inter_code
 into :s_attribute_code_desc, :status_flag,
 :stop_label_flag, :s_inter_code
 from valid_attributes
 where attrib_group = :attrib_group and
 attrib_code = :attrib_code and
 status_flag != 'A' and
 unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_attribute_code_desc := '';
 show_error('1100');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :attrib_group = 'DON' and :attrib_code = '00' then
 :ctrl_blk_2.temp_donor_decision_code := 'S';
 elsif :attrib_group = 'DON' and :attrib_code = '14' then
 :ctrl_blk_2.temp_donor_decision_code := 'T';
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE'
 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;

 temp_cur_record := :system.trigger_record;
 temp_attrib_group := :attrib_group;
 temp_attrib_code := :attrib_code;
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :attrib_group is not null
 then
 if :attrib_group = temp_attrib_group and
 :attrib_code = temp_attrib_code and
 :system.trigger_record != temp_cur_record
 then
 go_record(temp_cur_record);
 GO_ITEM('attrib_code');
 show_error('0030');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 down;
 else
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop;
 clear_record;
 go_record(temp_cur_record);
 begin
 select min(parm_code)
 into :unit_attributes.parm_code
 from valid_attrib_equip
 where attrib_group = :unit_attributes.attrib_group
 and attrib_code = :unit_attributes.attrib_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :unit_attributes.parm_code := null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 GO_ITEM('attrib_code');
end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-INSERT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :unit_attributes.unit_id := :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id;
 :unit_attributes.coll_date := :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date;
 :unit_attributes.chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :unit_attributes.insert_dats := sysdate;
 :unit_attributes.insert_user_id := :banner.user_id;
 if :attrib_code != :old_attrib_code or
 :attrib_group != :old_attrib_code
 then
 :unit_attributes.program_id := :banner.prog_name;
 end if;
 if :s_inter_code is not null
 then
 insert into unit_interdictions
 (unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id, inter_code, insert_dats,
 inter_user_id, program_id)
 select :ctrl_blk_2.unit_id, :ctrl_blk_2.coll_date ,
 :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id , :s_inter_code ,
 sysdate, :banner.user_id, :banner.prog_name
 from valid_interdictions_lab
 where inter_code = :s_inter_code
 and inter_code not in (select inter_code
 from unit_interdictions

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_start_code varchar2(3) := '+';
 temp_end_code varchar2(3) := '+';
 temp_len number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 temp_len := NVL(length(temp_start_code), 0);
 if :s_equip_reference = 'M'
 then
 NEXT_ITEM;
 else
 if NVL(length(:s_equip_reference), 0) !=
 6 + NVL(length(temp_start_code), 0) + NVL(length(temp_end_code), 0)
 then
 :s_equip_reference := null;
 show_error ('1210'); --invalid scan length
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if nvl(substr(:s_equip_reference, 1, temp_len),'nullx') !=
 nvl(temp_start_code,'nullx') or
 nvl(substr(:s_equip_reference, 7 + temp_len,
 NVL(length(temp_start_code), 0)),'nullx') !=
 nvl(temp_end_code,'nullx')
 then
 :s_equip_reference := null;
 show_error ('6076'); --invalid start/end code
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :equip_reference := 'EQ-'||substr(:s_equip_reference,
 temp_len + 1, 6);
 begin
 select e.equip_type, v.code_desc, serial_number
 into :equip_type, :equip_type_desc, :serial_number
 from valid_attrib_equip a, equip_master_codes v,
 equipment e
 where e.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id
 and e.equip_reference = :equip_reference
 and e.equip_type = v.code
 and v.code_type = 'EQUIP'
 and e.equip_type = a.equip_type
 and a.attrib_group = :unit_attributes.attrib_group
 and a.attrib_code = :unit_attributes.attrib_code
 and sysdate between a.eff_date
 and nvl(a.term_date, sysdate)
 and sysdate between v.eff_date
 and nvl(v.term_date, sysdate)
 and status = 'IN'
 and first_production_date <= trunc(sysdate);
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 :s_equip_reference := null;
 show_error ('3101'); --invalid equipment
 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 go_block('unit_attributes');
 execute_trigger('key-down');
 end if;
end;
